The '''Beheboth system''' was an eight-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
